correctness.rationale: Condition on the unordered pair of sampled polygon edges, with weights ell_i^2/P^2 for same edge and 2 ell_i ell_j/P^2 for distinct edges. For nonparallel edges the midpoint affine map has determinant ell_i ell_j |sin alpha|/4, giving planar density 8/(P^2 |sin alpha|) on each midpoint parallelogram. For a single edge, the average of independent uniforms has density 4min(z,1-z) and total mass ell_i^2/P^2. Distinct parallel edges push to a segment with 1D density 4/P^2 times the overlap of projected intervals, total mass 2ell_i ell_j/P^2; convexity puts positive-mass portions inside the polygon. The three cases exhaust pairs, including arbitrary nonadjacent parallelism. An odd regular n-gon has no such pair, even n has n/2, hence singular mass 1/n versus 2/n. For centrally symmetric 2m-gons opposite sides have lengths L_k and s=Sum L_k^2/(Sum L_k)^2>=1/m, equality precisely equal lengths. Independent exact rectangle mass=5/18 boundary+5/18 interior+4/9 bulk, 21 regular parity orders, and three separate trapezoid quadratures corroborate normalization. These computations are finite; the Jacobian/convolution proof is general.
residual_risks: Finite independent tests do not certify any unrestricted theorem; analytical argument and published structural lemmas carry generality.
